mainTopic: Testing רבי יהושע's principle that a bird עולה offered below can become a חטאת העוף, against the משניות in קנים
overview: The גמרא tests the principle of רבי יהושע, as רב אדא בר אהבה explained it: a bird עולה offered below the red line can switch over and become a חטאת העוף. First it brings a משנה from קנים about two women whose birds got mixed up. In that משנה, if one bird was offered above and one below, both are פסול. The גמרא answers that רבי יהושע only said his principle about one person's own offering, not when the bird belongs to someone else. Then it brings a second משנה about three pairs of birds. There, the specified pair is פסול even though it has a set owner. The גמרא insists that you cannot simply say קנים disagrees with רבי יהושע. To show this, it starts quoting a third משנה about a woman who owes a vow pair and a birth pair, and the כהן offered them wrongly. That quote continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A משנה about two women's mixed-up birds
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a משנה in קנים. Two women's birds got mixed up, a חטאת for one and an עולה for the other. If one bird was offered above the red line and one below, both are פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: a sin offering for this woman and a burnt offering for that woman. If the priest did both above, half is valid and half is invalid. If he did both below, half is valid and half is invalid. If he did one above and one below, both are invalid, because I say: maybe the sin offering was offered above and the burnt offering was offered below.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a משנה that it will use in the next step to challenge רבי יהושע's principle. This step only sets up the source.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A bird חטאת must be done below the red line, and a bird עולה above it. Doing both birds in the same place makes sure one of them was done right. Splitting them up might mean both were done in the wrong place, so the משנה rules both פסול.

keyTerms.meaning: Sin offering. A bird חטאת is done below the red line.
Burnt offering. A bird עולה is done above the red line.
Above or below the red line on the מזבח.
Half is valid and half is invalid. Here that means one bird out of two.
For I say. It brings in a worry about what might have happened.

steps.confusionAlert: "Half is valid" does not mean we know which bird is the valid one. It only means one of the two was surely done right.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
phrases.notes: What follows is a משנה from מסכת קנים.

phrases.english: a sin offering for this one and a burnt offering for that one;
phrases.notes: Two women each still owe one bird, and nobody knows which bird is which.

phrases.english: if he did both of them above,
half is valid and half is invalid.
If both of them were below,
half is valid and half is invalid.
If one was above and one was below,
both of them are invalid;
for I say:
the sin offering was offered above,
and the burnt offering was offered below.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a source to test the principle of רבי יהושע discussed earlier on the daf.
steps.raayaObject: The principle of רבי יהושע as explained by רב אדא בר אהבה
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה in קנים about two women's mixed-up bird offerings

steps.title: The עולה done below should turn into a חטאת
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the משנה. By רבי יהושע's principle, even if the עולה was done below, it should turn into a חטאת העוף and be valid.
steps.simpleTranslation: Even if we grant that the burnt offering was offered below, let it shift over and become a bird sin offering!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks using the משנה. According to רבי יהושע, the משנה should not have said that both birds are פסול.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב אדא בר אהבה explained רבי יהושע to mean that a bird עולה done below can switch over and count as a חטאת העוף. If so, in the case of one bird above and one below, the bird done below is valid either way. If it was the חטאת, it was done correctly. If it was the עולה, it turns into a חטאת. So the משנה's ruling that both are פסול seems to go against רבי יהושע.

keyTerms.meaning: Even if we grant. It accepts a point and then pushes further.
Let it be drawn over, meaning let it shift its status.
A bird sin offering

phrases.english: Granted, the burnt offering was offered below,
let it shift over and become a bird sin offering!
phrases.notes: This follows רבי יהושע's principle as רב אדא בר אהבה explained it earlier.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the משנה from step 1 to challenge רבי יהושע's principle.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב אדא בר אהבה's explanation of רבי יהושע: a bird עולה done below becomes a חטאת העוף
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If that principle is true, the bird done below should be valid in every case. So the משנה should not rule that both birds are פסול.

steps.title: רבי יהושע spoke about one person, not two
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that רבי יהושע only said his principle when the offering belongs to one person. Here the bird done below might belong to the other woman, so it cannot become her חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: Say that רבי יהושע said this about one person. Did he say it about two people?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back the challenge. It limits רבי יהושע's principle to a single person's own offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An עולה can switch into a חטאת only for the same owner. In the משנה, the עולה belongs to the woman who already brought her חטאת. If her bird was done below, it cannot become a חטאת for the other woman. So the משנה does not go against רבי יהושע.

keyTerms.meaning: Say that. It brings in a limit on what was said.
About one person
About two people
Did he say? Here it means: no, he did not.

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהושע's principle that an עולת העוף done below becomes a חטאת העוף works only within one person's offering. It does not work when the bird belongs to someone else.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets a clear limit on how far the switch from עולה to חטאת can go. It keeps the principle from clashing with the משנה in קנים.

phrases.english: Say that Rabbi Yehoshua said it
about one person;
about two people, did he say it?!
phrases.notes: In the משנה the bird might belong to the other woman, so it can't become this woman's חטאת.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 2 by showing that the משנה's case is different.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the use of the משנה in קנים as a challenge to רבי יהושע
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The challenge assumed the switch from עולה to חטאת works even when the bird belongs to a different person. רבי יהושע only said it about one person's own offering.

steps.title: A second משנה about three pairs of birds
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a משנה in קנים about two women who brought three pairs of birds together, and lists which birds are valid depending on where the כהן offered them.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: A pair set as a חטאת and an עולה, an unspecified pair, and a specified pair. If the כהן offered all of them above the red line, half are valid and half are not. If he offered all of them below, half are valid and half are not. If he offered half above and half below, only the unspecified pair is valid, and it is split between the two women.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new source, another משנה in קנים. It is setting up a fresh challenge to רבי יהושע's principle.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An עולת העוף belongs above the red line and a חטאת העוף belongs below it. If everything went above, the עולות are fine and the חטאות are not. If everything went below, it is the reverse. When the כהן did half above and half below, the unspecified pair works, because his action decides which bird is which. The specified birds may each have gone to the wrong side, so they are not valid.

keyTerms.meaning: An unspecified pair; it was never decided which bird is the חטאת and which is the עולה
A specified pair; each bird already has a set role
Half valid and half invalid
It is split between them, one bird for each woman

steps.confusionAlert: 'Half above and half below' means half of every pair, without knowing which bird went where. That is why the specified birds might each be on the wrong side.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
A sin offering and a burnt offering,
and an unspecified pair, and a specified pair –
if he offered all of them above the red line –
half are valid and half are invalid.
All of them below –
half are valid and half are invalid.
Half of them above and half of them below –
only the unspecified pair is valid,
and it is divided between them.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the first משנה was answered in step 3, the גמרא brings a second משנה in קנים to test רבי יהושע's principle again.
steps.raayaObject: Testing רבי יהושע's principle that a misplaced עולה can become a חטאת העוף
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה in קנים about three pairs of birds brought by two women

steps.title: Why aren't the specified birds valid?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the specified pair fails. Even if its עולה was offered below, רבי יהושע's principle should let it become a חטאת העוף.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the specified birds are not valid. Why not? Even if the עולה was offered below, it should be drawn over and become a חטאת העוף!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out that the משנה invalidates the specified birds. It asks why, given רבי יהושע's principle.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to רבי יהושע, an עולה done below the line can be switched into a חטאת העוף. The specified pair already has a set owner, so the 'two people' answer from step 3 does not help here, and the specified birds should be saved. The משנה's ruling that they are invalid seems to go against this principle.

keyTerms.meaning: But why?
Even granting that...
Let it be drawn over, meaning switched into a different offering
A bird sin offering, which is done below the red line

phrases.english: Whereas the specified ones are not valid;
But why?
Even if the burnt offering was offered below,
let it be drawn over and become a bird sin offering!
phrases.notes: This is the same push from רבי יהושע's principle that the גמרא used in step 2.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the משנה quoted in step 4 to attack רבי יהושע's principle.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב אדא בר אהבה's explanation of רבי יהושע: a bird עולה done below becomes a חטאת העוף
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: By רבי יהושע's principle, an עולה offered below should turn into a valid חטאת העוף, so the specified birds should not be invalid.

steps.title: You can't say this משנה ignores רבי יהושע
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא blocks the easy answer that this משנה does not follow רבי יהושע, saying that answer is impossible.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you will say this משנה does not follow רבי יהושע, can you really say that?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא imagines someone answering that this משנה simply disagrees with רבי יהושע. It immediately rejects that answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The easiest way out of the question would be to say the משנה follows a different opinion. The גמרא says that escape is closed, so the question in step 5 still stands. The reason it cannot be said comes next.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you will say: the גמרא raises a possible answer
Can you really say that? Meaning: that is not possible

steps.confusionAlert: This line does not answer the question. It shuts down one possible answer, so the challenge is still open.

phrases.aramaic: וְכִי תֵּימָא הָא דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ –
phrases.english: And if you will say this is not in accordance with Rabbi Yehoshua –
can you really say that?!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי תֵּימָא הָא דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes off a possible answer to the challenge in step 5, so the challenge stays strong.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the suggested answer that the משנה does not follow רבי יהושע
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The גמרא says this answer cannot be given; it explains why next.

steps.title: A woman who vowed a pair of birds and also owed one
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins quoting a משנה in קנים. A woman owes two pairs of birds, one for a vow and one for giving birth, so the כהן should offer three birds above the red line and one below.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: A woman said, "I take upon myself to bring a pair of birds if I give birth to a boy." She gave birth to a boy, so she brings two pairs: one for her vow and one for her obligation. She gave them to the כהן. The כהן must offer three of the birds above the red line and one below.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts bringing a new משנה from קנים to show that קנים follows רבי יהושע. This step sets up the case, and the next steps continue quoting the same משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A vow pair is two עולות, which are offered above the red line. The birth obligation is one עולה above and one חטאת below. So the right total is three above and one below, and this is the baseline the mistake in the next step is measured against.

keyTerms.meaning: A nest: a pair of bird offerings
Her vow: the extra pair she promised
Her obligation: the pair every woman brings after giving birth
Above or below the red line around the מזבח. An עולה is done above and a חטאת below.

steps.confusionAlert: The vow pair is not an עולה and a חטאת like the birth pair. A vow can only produce עולות, so both birds of the vow pair go above.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
A woman who said:
"It is upon me to bring a nest
phrases.notes: A "nest" here means a pair of birds brought as offerings.

phrases.english: if I give birth to a boy";
she gave birth to a boy:
she brings two nests,
one for her vow and one for her obligation.
She gave them to the priest,
so the priest must offer them
three above and one below.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Step 6 said it is impossible that the משנה in קנים does not follow רבי יהושע. This step brings another משנה from קנים as evidence for that claim.
steps.raayaObject: That the משניות in קנים follow רבי יהושע
steps.raayaSupportSource: A משנה in קנים about a woman with a vow pair and a birth pair of birds

steps.title: The priest offered two above and two below
steps.stepSummary: The כהן mistakenly offered two birds above and two below without asking her. She must bring one more bird to offer above. If the two pairs were of different kinds of birds, she must bring two birds.
steps.simpleTranslation: If the כהן did not do this, but offered two above and two below without consulting her, she must bring one more single bird and offer it above. This applies when both pairs were of one kind of bird. If they were of two kinds, she must bring two birds.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the ruling for the כהן's mistake: she is missing one עולה, so she brings one more bird for above. If the pairs were different kinds of birds, she brings two.
steps.deeperAnalysis: She needed three birds above but only got two, so one עולה is missing. Of the two birds done below, one counts as her חטאת, and the other bird does not count as anything she owed. If the pairs were of different kinds, nobody knows which kind is still owed, so she brings one of each to cover both possibilities.

keyTerms.meaning: Consulted: the כהן asked the woman before offering
A single bird, not a pair
Kind or species of bird, either תורים or בני יונה

steps.whatToRemember: With one owner and one kind of bird, the fix is one extra bird above. With two kinds, she brings two birds because it is unclear which kind is missing.

phrases.english: If he did not do so,
but rather offered two above
and two below,
and did not consult her,
she must bring one more single bird
and offer it above.
This is when they were of one kind.
But if they were of two kinds,
she brings two.

steps.triggerLanguage: לֹא עָשָׂה כֵּן, אֶלָּא עָשָׂה שְׁתַּיִם לְמַעְלָה וּשְׁתַּיִם לְמַטָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: This step continues the quoted משנה and gives the ruling for the כהן's mistake. The גמרא keeps quoting this משנה to show that the משניות in קנים follow רבי יהושע.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The continuation of the same משנה in קנים, which the גמרא keeps quoting to show it follows רבי יהושע

steps.title: She named the kind of bird for her vow and then forgot it
steps.stepSummary: If the woman had named which kind of bird she would bring for her vow but forgot which kind, she must bring three more birds when both pairs were one kind. If the two pairs were of two different kinds, she must bring four.
steps.simpleTranslation: If she specified her vow, she must bring three more birds. That is when both pairs were of one kind. If they were of two kinds, she must bring four.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא continues quoting the משנה in קנים with a harder version of the same mix-up. This time the woman had named which kind of bird she would bring for her vow, and then she forgot which kind it was.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since she forgot which kind she named, she must cover both possibilities. If both pairs were one kind, she brings one bird of that kind to replace the one wrongly offered below, plus two birds of the other kind in case that is what she named. If the pairs were of two kinds and the כהן does not know which pair he offered first, she may still owe a whole vow of either kind, so she brings four, two of each kind.

keyTerms.meaning: She specified, meaning she named exactly which kind of bird she would bring
Her vow, the birds she promised on her own as a voluntary עולה
Single birds, not pairs
A kind of bird. Here it means either תּוֹרִים (turtledoves) or בְּנֵי יוֹנָה (young pigeons)

steps.confusionAlert: Do not read 'three' or 'four' as pairs. They are single birds, and all of them are offered above the red line as עולות.

phrases.english: If she specified her vow,
phrases.notes: She had said which kind of bird she would bring for her vow, but later forgot which kind it was.

phrases.english: she must bring three more single birds.
phrases.notes: Some versions have the word in square brackets and some don't.

phrases.english: This is when the pairs were of one kind.
But if they were of two kinds, she brings four.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a harder case to the case in step 8. Here she also forgot which kind of bird she named for her vow.
steps.raayaObject: That the משניות in קנים follow רבי יהושע, the claim made in step 6

steps.title: Opening the case where she also fixed how her vow was to be offered
steps.stepSummary: The משנה begins a new, harder case. Here the woman also committed to offering her vow birds together with the עולה of her required pair.
steps.whatsHappening: This line only opens the next case. The גמרא is setting up the next move, and the ruling comes in the following words.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Besides naming a kind of bird and forgetting it, the woman also committed to offering the vow birds together with the עולה of her required pair. This new detail makes the calculation more complicated, and the משנה will now say how many birds she must bring.

keyTerms.meaning: She fixed, meaning she committed to a set way of offering her vow birds

phrases.english: If she fixed her vow,
phrases.notes: She tied her vow birds to the עולה of her required pair. The ruling comes on the next amud.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next, harder case in the same משנה.
steps.raayaObject: Continuing the קנים material the גמרא is quoting
